BETA
Widgets are not in this beta
Today check-offs and reminders work inside the app. No native home-screen widget or live activity target ships in this release.
This route does not offer a preview, OS control, or paid widget upgrade.

BETA
Photo trend insights are not in this beta
The photo timeline stays local-first and score-free. No validated trend engine ships in this release.
No Trend consent is requested. Progress photos remain useful without change claims.
